skills.name: academic-humanizer
skills.description: Polish scholarly prose for clarity, evidence-aligned claims, calibrated limitations, and venue voice. Use for Stage 4 language review; do not optimize for AI detectors.

skills.name: citation-verification
skills.description: Verify citation metadata and support for manuscript claims during drafting or pre-submission; never invent references.

skills.name: claim-numerics-audit
skills.description: Check manuscript numbers against experiment records, figures, tables, configurations, and units; report mismatches without silent edits.

skills.name: cover-letter
skills.description: Prepare a journal submission cover letter when requested or during Stage 6.

skills.name: experiment-plan
skills.description: Design claim-driven experiments, baselines, metrics, ablations, statistics, run order, compute budget, and stop rules after method refinement.

skills.name: experiment-runner
skills.description: Run planned local-first training or evaluation with provenance and immutable run records. Use for Stage 2 execution; cloud launches need authorization.

skills.name: journal-scout
skills.description: Find and compare target journals after the research question and data are defined. Use for Stage 1B or explicit venue-selection requests.

skills.name: paper-audit
skills.description: Review complete or revised academic manuscripts for scientific, methodological, citation, numerical, and presentation issues. Use for peer-review or readiness audits, not direct editing or compilation.

skills.name: paper-illustration
skills.description: Create non-data scientific figures such as method diagrams, mechanisms, and conceptual schematics; use editable vector tools when appropriate.

skills.name: paper-plan
skills.description: Plan an evidence-led paper from verified claims, results, and venue constraints. Use before drafting to map its narrative, sections, figures, limitations, and evidence.

skills.name: paper-write
skills.description: Draft or revise an academic manuscript from an approved plan and verified evidence. Use for Stage 4, translation, section drafting, or LaTeX preparation.

skills.name: research-data-audit
skills.description: Audit research data provenance, licensing, schema, quality, leakage, split integrity, and sensitive-data risks before modeling or after dataset changes.

skills.name: research-ideation
skills.description: Develop literature-grounded research questions and testable candidates. Use for novelty checks, topic selection, or Stage 1C; search absence does not prove novelty.

skills.name: research-publication
skills.description: Prepare or audit a reproducible research release package, including code/data documentation, licenses, cards, checksums, and archive metadata. Publishing needs authorization.

skills.name: research-quality-gate
skills.description: Evaluate evidence-based Gate A-F decisions against project records. Use at research checkpoints; identify decisive gaps and route failures to concrete repairs.

skills.name: research-refine
skills.description: Refine an accepted, evidence-backed idea into a minimal method, mechanism hypothesis, failure modes, and claim-driven validation plan.

skills.name: result-to-claim
skills.description: Assess which completed experiments support, weaken, reject, or leave claims unresolved; separate performance, mechanism, and generalization evidence.

skills.name: scientific-figure-making
skills.description: Create publication figures from data with claim-aware charts, honest scales and uncertainty, export, and visual QA. Use for plots, not diagrams.
